mission_07: Excellent work on heterogeneous GNNs! You have built a model that can handle graphs with multiple node and edge types, each with their own learned transformations. This is crucial for real-world applications like recommendation systems (users, items, categories), knowledge graphs (entities, relations), and biological networks (genes, proteins, drugs). The type-specific approach allows the model to capture the unique semantics of each relationship type. By aggregating messages across different edge types, your model can reason about complex multi-relational patterns that homogeneous GNNs would miss.
